title: KKR Real Estate Finance Trust Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.10 Per Share of Common Stock
summary: NEW YORK, September 18, 2026--KKR Real Estate Finance Trust Inc. (the "Company" or "KREF") (NYSE: KREF) announced that the Board of Directors has declared a dividend of $0.10 per share of common stock with respect to the third quarter of 2026. The dividend is payable on October 15, 2026 to KREF’s common stockholders of record as of September 30, 2026.
